body.statement: For each \(u\in\mathcal R\), \(-2t^{-2}\log|\phi_X(tu)|\to u^\top\Gamma u\) as \(|t|\to\infty\); coordinate and pair-sum polarization therefore identify every entry of \(\Gamma\) from \(P_X\).
body.justification: This is the population bridge from the observed law to the causal covariance.
body.gap: Sanjaroonpouri--Ramazi's Theorems 2--3 identify a finite SCM class under mutually independent nonconstant Gaussian-indecomposable sources, \(1\le k\le p\), lexicographically ordered loading columns, and full column rank; they do not state this greatest-divisor ray functional or a sampling region for it.
body.consumer: It lets an analyst audit covariance identification without estimating latent source labels.
